core_obligations: The base case: for k equal to three the proof combines the expansion inequality with the first term of the boundary estimate and checks the numerical inequality (proof lines 819-822).
The middle range: for k between four and d cubed the same two inputs give a linear bound in k which the author verifies to dominate the claimed expression (proof lines 823-826).

The large range: for k between d cubed and twice u_1 the proof uses the second term of the boundary estimate, reaching an expression containing the logarithm of d, and then simplifies it using the bound on p_- (proof lines 827-835).
Conclusion: in every range the boundary function dominates the claimed lower bound, which is the statement (proof lines 835-837).
proof_roadmap: k = 3 时由展开不等式与 f^* 的第一项直接验证；4 ≤ k ≤ d^3 时同法给出线性于 k 的界。
d^3 < k ≤ 2u_1 时用 f^* 的第二项得到含 ln d 的表达式，再用 p_- 的上界化简，三段合起来即为所证。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the quantitative boundary bound used in the Tutte-obstruction estimates (author lemma at source lines 811-816, label lem:strong-boundary, whose statement carries the author's own labelled display eq:strong-3d). The proof (source lines 818-838) splits the range of the size parameter into three pieces and in each piece evaluates the two available estimates on the boundary function, checking the numerical inequalities explicitly; the large range additionally uses the bound on p_- (proof lines 827-835). The range split and the arithmetic are the content. H2.
